hint: tap anywhere to catch the sunrise

game.q: the man doesn’t move. he asks shankara one question:

wrong.rude: fair question. but he asked a deeper one.
wrong.coffee: a real morning question. not this morning.

game.right: YES. if the self in every person is one, who is moving away from whom?

end.line: a great teacher told a man to move, got his own teaching handed back, and bowed.

cliff.s1: a farmer’s cart is stuck in the mud.
cliff.s2: so he asks a god to lift it.

share: “move aside,” said the teacher. “move what?” said the man. a traditional story on infinite hill
